description: Use this when the user wants to add page numbers to a PDF, number the pages of a PDF, put "Page 1 of 10" in a footer or header, or skip numbering the cover page. Takes one attached PDF, a format with {n} (this page's number) and optional {total} (the last number), one of six positions, start number, pages to skip at the start, font size and margin, and returns a new PDF. Each stamp is checked again in the new file before the link is given. Does not open password-protected PDFs, does not draw non-Latin scripts or emoji, and does not change the page content under the number. Do not use for Bates numbers (use stamp_bates_numbers).

file.description: The PDF to number, e.g. report.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

font_size.description: Font size in points from 6 to 36, e.g. 10 (default).

format.description: Text with {n} and optional {total}, e.g. "Page {n} of {total}" (default), "{n}", "{n}/{total}" or "- {n} -".

margin_pt.description: Distance from the page edge in points from 6 to 144, e.g. 36 (half an inch, default).

position.description: Where the text goes on each page as viewed: top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right. Default bottom-center.

skip_first.description: How many pages at the start get no number, e.g. 1 for a cover page. Default 0.

start_number.description: Number for the first numbered page, e.g. 1 (default).

name: stamp_page_numbers
title: Number PDF pages
